assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas for a top-down 2D survival bunker game, fortification level 1 of 5. Create EXACTLY THREE separated sprites, NO labels or text, on genuinely transparent background. Canvas landscape 1536x1024. Strict orthographic TOP-DOWN view, no isometric camera, no perspective convergence. Muted charcoal, grey-green concrete, dark steel, small warm weathered edges; realistic material detail but coherent illustrated game assets. Sprite A occupies upper half: one uninterrupted long horizontal rectangular concrete wall section, footprint aspect ratio 4:1, nearly full canvas width with margin. This wall has a walkable wide flat dark concrete top/catwalk. A heavy high parapet ONLY along its upper/north exterior edge, clearly thick protective concrete cap. Lower/south courtyard edge is low, open to allow jumping inward. Left and right ends are FLUSH cut ends for seamless connection to another wall, NO endcaps/railings/towers/pedestals/guns. Sprite B bottom LEFT: square wall corner platform seen from directly above, high parapet along NORTH and WEST edges ONLY, open EAST and SOUTH edges flush for joining wall sections; same width/material as straight wall; NO gun socket. Sprite C bottom RIGHT: narrow straight steel staircase seen from directly above, from lower/south ground level to upper/north wall top, 8 even treads, thin handrails on both sides; same muted practical industrial design as corner, NOT a diagonal or isometric ladder. All 3 separated with generous transparent gaps. Soft neutral light, no cast shadow beyond objects, no floor or scene. Level 1 material: sturdy coarse poured reinforced concrete with minimal plain steel braces, intact new wall with NO damage cracks. Individual sprites completely in frame. No decorative freestanding square mounts. Main art should read crisply at mobile game scale.
